outcome: glucose metabolism (fasting glucose, insulin, C-peptide, HOMA-IR, fasting glucose during OGTT)
cohort: 1486 pregnant women participating in a prospective double-center cohort study.
finding: An unappropriated FT4/TSH ratio in the first trimester was identified as an independent risk factor for Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM) in women carrying male fetuses.
